ten: Moi lan co tin hieu la them mot lenh
mo_ta: Khong co khoang cach co dinh: moi tin hieu vao (vd RSI < 15 tren M5) them mot lenh cung chieu, ke ca dang am (GoldHunter: hang tram lenh).
vet: Khoang cach gia giua lenh them khong deu, co the dao chieu (them o gia tot hon hoac xau hon).

engine.ghi_chu: luoi.py them theo buoc gia, khong theo tin hieu.

ap_cheo: Neu tin hieu tot hon luoi co dinh thi lenh them nen nam o 'day nhip' chu khong o moi buoc; so tung thang.
rui_ro: Tin hieu bam day nhieu lan: don lot o gia xau.
bang_chung_ghi_chu: chua co (the moi gieo, chua do)
